holds.reason: Cirion identifies LIM2 as entering service in 2025. On October 22 Juan Pablo Torres Paz published a first-person account of a systems engineering group visiting Cirion’s Lurín data center and described how the installed infrastructure supported service. His original post leaves the visit date unstated. An October 15 event at LIM2 is mentioned in a separate indexed profile extract whose original dated post was not recovered. The September executive interview concerns future scaling. No exact, in-window, facility-specific operator or attributable project-participant observation was established.
holds.scope: The operator-published facility marker and the certifier independently identify the property. It is separate from Gtd Lurín, 194 metres away.
